scientific_integrity: All-length proof from a finite-state language equivalence and an exact polynomial vector certificate; independent finite deletion-shadow enumeration is corroboration. No independent scientific audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-length edge enumerator concerns linear indexed binary words avoiding 11 and two source words subject to exactly one arbitrary-symbol deletion each. It is not a statement of exact maximum code size, multiple-deletion behavior, or a circular constraint; historical priority cannot be exhaustive.
title: Exact deletion-confusability spectrum of Fibonacci-constrained binary words
